relationships.evidence_quote: The expression level of P2X7R continuously rose in a time-dependent manner following repeated intermittent NTG injection.

key_findings: Recurrent NTG impairs autophagic flux in the TNC; P2X7R (microglial) promotes microglial/NLRP3 activation and CGRP/c-fos expression by suppressing autophagy.
Both rapamycin and P2X7R antagonist BBG relieved hyperalgesia and reduced CGRP, c-fos, NLRP3, IL-1β and IL-18.
